inventory_rules: every REQUIRED_STAGES member has at least one independently specified normative test
A01 through A13 are explicitly inventoried rather than collapsed into one generic matrix test
tests are derived from contracts and synthetic fixtures, not from I_A expected answers
I_A and O outputs are forbidden construction inputs before I_B result seal
stage tests may reuse generic fixture-building primitives but not project semantic builders
cross-cutting boundary tests cover traversal invariance, status axes, sealing, isolation, missing-input defaults and source-to-logical corruption
future executable tests must bind to the final I_B source digest after independent implementation

source_binding_protocol.final_binding_requirement: source_digests must exactly equal the future I_B implementation manifest source_digests
source_binding_protocol.adjudication_rule: pre-code evidence qualification does not by itself qualify I_B executable implementation
source_binding_protocol.post_code_mutation_guard: frozen semantic payload hashes must remain exactly equal to the pre-code breaker constants

blocked_semantic_dependencies.required_test_behavior: unverified claimed proof must not promote A08; fail closed as A07 / QUALIFICATION_BLOCKED
